description: This file defines the AWS ChimeSDKVoiceClient class, which extends AwsClient and provides methods to interact with the Amazon Chime SDK Voice service, including operations for managing phone numbers, voice connectors, SIP media applications, and related resources.

classes.name: ChimeSDKVoiceClient
classes.description: Client class for Amazon Chime SDK Voice service, providing methods for various voice and communication operations.

methods.name: associatePhoneNumbersWithVoiceConnector
methods.description: Associates phone numbers with a voice connector.

methods.name: associatePhoneNumbersWithVoiceConnectorAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously associates phone numbers with a voice connector.

methods.name: createPhoneNumberOrder
methods.description: Creates a new order for phone numbers.

methods.name: getVoiceConnector
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific voice connector.
